title: Here are the top AI agents that can live in your text messages
hook_text: AI agents now live in your texts.
script:
TechCrunch published a guide on October twenty fourth detailing AI agents built for text messaging.
These assistants skip separate apps to function directly inside standard messaging threads.
The roundup covers options ranging from general assistants to agents designed for families, travel, and work.
They bring automated help straight to daily personal communications without requiring extra software downloads.
Would you let an AI agent manage your chats?
